scope: Only the four exact historical scope/execution/estimate messages are reclassified. Unrecognized notices, provider-specific conditions and unresolved academic policy fields remain blockers.

originalMessages.personal: Individual catalog eligibility, state CPA eligibility, course currency and registration availability depend on the student; this plan does not make a licensure or admissions decision.
originalMessages.retained: Existing receiving-school transfer candidates retain their original provider/version/format restrictions. No additional provider award is inferred from a matching course title.
originalMessages.residency: The standard nonmilitary residency route is modeled. Military enrollment, foreign-credit rules and Edison Accelerate require a separately evaluated scenario.
originalMessages.pricing: Published tuition is a planning basis; books, provider subscriptions and applicable fees are separate.
